tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru bhyaḥrdo rje 'chang chen sha ba ri dbang phyug/mai tri pa dang sgra gcan 'dzin
༄༅/ /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so/ /༈/na mo gu ru bhyaḥrdo rje 'chang chen sha ba ri dbang phyug/mai tri pa dang sgra gcan 'dzin

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i sgrub thabs bzhugs so// ༈ /na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rdo rje 'chang chen sha ba ri dbang phyug /mai tri pa dang sgra gcan 'dzin sbas pa// khyung po rnal 'byor rin chen brtson 'grus dang*// skyer sgang chos seng gnyen ston rnal 'byor zhabs// sangs rgyas ston pa mkhas grub gtsang pa shang*// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang bla ma rdor gzhon mtshan// nam mkha'i rnal 'byor byang sems sbyin pa bzang*// thang stong rgyal po blo gros rgyal mtshan zhabs// dpal ldan dar po zhi dgon bsod nams rtse// 'gyur med bde chen ngag dbang chos kyi grags// rgyal mtshan bkra shis dpal ldan buddhā'i mtshan// sangs rgyas phun tshogs bstan 'dzin lhun grub zhabs// bkra shis lhun grub dpal ldan chos skyong dang*// rin chen mchog grub nam mkha' 'chi med dang*// kun dga' bstan 'dzin bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhabs// 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse dbang dang blo gter zhabs// bka' drin mnyam med shes rab rgya mtsho sogs/

/yang na/ /mkhyen brtse dbang po kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs// bstan pa'i nyi ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs// dngos brgyud bla ma mgon dkar yid bzhin nor// mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin nor bdag phyogs dang bcas// 'khor dang bcas la rtse gcig gsol ba 'debs// dpal 'byor phrin las rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// stobs 'byor blo ldan skye 'gro longs spyod bcas// bdag gi dbang bsdus chos dang srid pa'i dpal// 'dzad med gter la dbang 'byor rgyal bstan dang*// 'gro phan phrin las rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs dngos grub dbyig gter 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad dbul phongs kyi sdug bsngal bsal nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod par bya/ de'i ched du mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/

sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgom/ rang gi snying ga'i dkyil du thig le dmar po rgya sran tsam pa de'i dkyil du hūm̐ dkar po dngul chu dwangs pa'i mdog lta bu gcig bsgom/ de gnyis las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus de gnyis la thim/ snying ga'i hūm̐ dang thig le ro gcig tu 'dres pa las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po yid bzhin nor bu/ sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ zhal gcig 'dzum zhing khro ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag drug pa/ g.yas kyi dang pos gri gug 'phyar ba/ gnyis pas yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gsum pas ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos thod pa'i nang bum pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis gang ba brla g.yon la brten te 'dzin pa/ bar bas rtse gsum/ tha mas lcags kyu bsnams pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ sku smad la dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs dang rin po che'i chun 'phyang sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ zhabs gnyis dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas da lta rang byon pa 'dra ba/ 'byon 'phro la bzhugs pa 'dra ba'i zhabs 'og na tshogs bdag la phug dang ne'u le bzung ba re re mnan pa'i kha dang bshang lam thams cad nas rin po che lhug lhug 'ong ba/ mgon po'i spyi bor bla ma rdo rje 'chang dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan pa/ g.yas rin po che g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ mgon po'i thugs kar dbang sdud kyi mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon thod pa bsnams pa/ zhabs gnyis gar stabs ling nge ba/ spyan gsum nam mkha' la hrig hrig gzigs pa khams gsum dbang du sdud pa gcig tu gyur/ de'i snying gar chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po 'od 'phro ba/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dur khrod chen po bsil ba'i tshal nas mgon po mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la sa pa ri wa ra arghaṃ pra tītstsha swā hā/ pā dyaṃ pra tītstsha nas shabda pra tītstsha swā hā 'i bar dang*/ oṃ rū pa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ de bzhin du shabda/ gandhe/ ra sa/ sparṣe rnams kyis mchod/ nang mchod/ oṃ a mṛ ta sa bsang*/ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me dang*/ mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ bhrūm̐ ām̐ dzriṃ kham̐ hūm̐ las ye shes lnga rnams mes gdungs te bskol zhing zhu bas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha hoḥhrīḥ lan gsum brjod/ mtheb srin gyis 'thor ba'i tshul dang*/ rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma mgon po dbyer med kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes dang rang gis myang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro nor sbyin rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yul 'di'i gzhi bdag rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod la/ de nas bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying ga'i chos nyid kyi thig le dmar po'i mthar rtsa sngags bye ru'i phreng ba lta bus bskor ba las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i dbyibs can grangs med pa 'phros pas/ srid zhi'i dge legs dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rang dbang med par bsdus nas thig le la thim par bsam la/ gu ru ma hā kā la ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ

zhes pa ci nus bzla/ yang 'od zer sngar bzhin 'phros/ 'khor gyi mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas rgyud bskul/ srid pa gsum gyi dngos grub thams cad rim gyis bsdus nas rang gi mdun du zas nor longs spyod ri rab tsam spungs par gyur par bsam/ khyad par stobs 'byor che dgu thams cad kyi snying du 'od zer mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi rim pa dang bcas pa zhugs/ de dag gi rgyud rang dbang med par bskul nas bdag gi dbang du 'dus par gyur par bsam/ khyad par dmigs yul gyi snying dkyil rnam shes nṛ ljang gu nya mig tsam yod pa/ mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin rnams kyi snying ga'i 'od zer gyi lcags kyus tsir gyis bzung nas bdag gi dbang du byas par gyur par bsam pa ni mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin la brten pa'i zab khyad do// thun min tshogs bdag la brten pa'i zab khyad ni/ slar yang 'od zer 'phros pas 'jig rten gyi lha klu gnod sbyin stobs ldan rnams dang*/ mi'i dbang po la sogs pa'i stobs ldan thams cad bkug ste/ tshogs bdag la bstims pas/ de dag thams cad kyis rnal 'byor pa'i bka' bzhin du nyan cing*/ bran bzhin du las bsgrubs par gyur par bsam la bzlas pa bya/ bzlas pa'i mjug tu/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub myur mdzad mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ spro na/ bcom ldan 'das yid bzhin gzi ldan thugs rje can khyod la gsol ba 'debs so// sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs shig dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod cig dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs shig bla ma'i sku tshe srings shig rnal 'byor pa bdag la snyan pa'i grags pas sa steng ma lus par khyab pa dang*/

dgos 'dod thams cad char bzhin du babs nas longs spyod zad mi shes pa dang*/ mi nor zas gsum dbang du 'du zhing*/ thos bsam sgom gsum 'phel ba dang*/ phrin las 'bad med du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum/ zhes sogs gang 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ de dag ni bskyed rim mo// de nas nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu nas rang la thim/ rang nyid gdan dang bcas pa snying ga'i mkha' 'gro ma la thim/ de sngags phreng la thim/ de thig le la thim/ de hūm̐ yig la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du thim/ de yang 'od du yal ba'i ngang la ci tsam gnas kyi bar du mnyam par 'jog bzhag pa'i ngang la rig pa de rig stong*/ 'gyu ba de 'gyu stong*/ ma sgrib par gsal ba de gsal stong*/ yin min gyi mtha' dang bral bas rmi lam gyi snang ba/ sgyu ma'i rang bzhin zhes ngo sprod pa ni rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o// zhes shangs pa du gu ba bzhed do/ /slar yang de'i ngang nas lha yi skur ldangs la gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ram/ gnas gsum bsrung zhing*/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mgon dkar yid bzhin nor bu 'grub gyur nas sogs/ thams cad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin nas sogs/ 'bad dang rtsol bas ma gos pa'i sogs/ yon tan rab rdzogs gangs kyi ri bo bzhin// byin rlabs chu bo'i skal ldan tshim mdzad kyis// rang sems lhan cig skyes pa ston mdzad pa'i// chos rje bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la bu bzhin gzigs mdzad cing*// mi 'bral lus dang grib ma ji bzhin du// dam tshig can la dngos grub mchog ster ba'i// yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi bkra shis shog /dam can sgrub pa po yi rjes 'brang zhing*// zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang mngon spyod sogs// sna tshogs phrin las tshul bzhin sgrub mdzad pa'i// chos skyong srung ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog

/snang srid rang grol sgyu ma rmi lam bzhin// bde ba chen po rgyun chad med pa'i nyams// yid la byar med stong gsal nam mkha'i mdangs// bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i bkra shis shog /sgrub pa po la mchod cing bstod pa dang*// bskul ba 'debs pa'i skye 'gro gang yin pa// thams cad byang chub lam la 'god mdzad pa'i// mnyam nyid byang chub sems kyi bkra shis shog /'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa thams cad kyis// bkra shis go 'phang ji snyed yod pa kun// phun sum tshogs pa chu bo'i gzhung bzhin du// skye 'gro yongs la rtag tu bkra shis shog /bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin// snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab// tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun grub pa'i// yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog /byang phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal chen rnam thos sras// nor gyi bdag po arya dzambha la// dbul ba sel ba'i lha mo nor rgyun ma// nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi bkra shis shog /bstan pa dar zhing bstan 'dzin zhabs pad brtan// dge 'dun thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub 'phel// rgyal khams nad 'khrugs zhi zhing lo phyugs legs// dge bcu'i chos la sbyor ba'i bkra shis shog / bsngo ba smon lam gang shes bya// ༈ /oṃ swa sti/ ngag byin rlabs ni/ tho rangs gnyid sad ma thag sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa'i bsod nams kyis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / lan gsum/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lce steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du oṃ khyung po'i yig steng du oṃ yod/ de'i mthar g.yon skor du ā li kha dog dkar po/ de'i phyi rol g.yas skor du kā li kha dog dmar po swā hās mthar brten pa/ de'i phyi rol du g.yas skor du ye dharmā

'di bla ma phyi ma 'ga' res bcug pa 'dra yang nyes 'gal med/ kha dog sngon pos bskor bar gyur par bsam/ de dag las 'od zer 'phros sangs rgyas byang sems sogs 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi gsung gi byin rlabs dang grub pa rig 'dzin drang srong sogs kyi ngag gi dpal yon thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par bsdus te sngags phreng la thim par gyur par bsams la/ oṃ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ ai āai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa swā hā/ oṃ ye dharmā he tu pra bha wā he tunte ṣānta thā ga to hya ba da ta/ te ṣañtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī mahā shra ma ṇa swā hā/ lan gsum mam bdun re brjod/ mthar zla ba sngags phreng dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas lce la thim par gyur par bsams la dge sbyor gang yin la 'jug go /zhes yig rnying bzhin du wā gind+ras spel ba dge/ 'di bgyis bzlas brjod bye bar 'gyur// smras tshad sngags dang ngag mnan zhi// sngags kyi nus pa mi nyams gsungs// //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
